Sentence (English): I have had this for over a month and few things I would change about the dishwasher and the process.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, but some minor flaws ] || ---------------- || I have had this for over a month and few things I would change about the dishwasher and the process. First, I was replacing a 20-year old GE dishwasher that is built like a tank. It still worked, but never really dried the dishes well. This one was reviewed by Consumer Reports and did well, so we gave it a try. So, here are the highlights, if you are replacing an older dishwasher, you may need a new electrical box to connect it to your house. The installer had one, but it was an additional $100 on the spot, so add that to the cost. Second, my biggest complaint is that the door feels very flimsy and twists slightly when open and closing it. Third, there is no way to warn someone if you just washed dished or only used the rinse cycle. If someone opens it after the 9-minute rinse cycle they could potentially think the dishes were cleaned and try to put them away. I will probably add a "dirty/clean" magnet for others in the house to be aware of this, but that takes away from the clean aesthetic of the front. Fourth, the top rack gets really hot and has melted the coating off of some KitchenAid knives, so be careful. Lastly, the dryer seems to get things really dry about 50% of the time, so additional drying may still be needed especially on plastic items.As for the good, it cleans very, very well even though the cycle time is typically 2 hours. It is extremely quiet--I mean "really" quiet-- and it shows a solid red light on the floor when it's running so you can see that it's on at a glance. Its modular design is great for different sized items from pots and pans to small silverware. Overall, it is very easy to use even though 90% of the time I just use "Auto". Even with its faults, it's miles ahead of my old dishwasher. I would definitely buy it again just for the quiet operation. Did I mention it was quiet?

Sentence (English): I'll start by saying this is my first Bosch appliance and I'm extremely happy with it so far.
Comments (English): [ Phenomenal & Quiet Machine so far ] || ---------------- || I'll start by saying this is my first Bosch appliance and I'm extremely happy with it so far. I'm going to break this down simply by 2 things: Looks & Functionality and installation. Looks & Operation:This machine has a sleek, smooth look with no face mounted controls. I went with the top control model and have really been impressed with the ease of use. The door feels solid and has a nice snappy feel when it opens & closes without being too hard for impaired or elderly people to use. The inside is designed well with the 3 rack for utensils and the multiple spray bar configuration seems to really make perfect coverage when washing. I bought it on 9/27/23 so it's been a month of use multiple times per week and ive yet to find a speck of anything stuck to a plate or fork. I'm very impressed with the overall operation. Almost forgot the best part, it's SILENT when running! The App is well thought out and functional. I use it to set a later time to start or to see how much tine is left on a cycle. Well doneI happen to be an Electrician so I've installed plenty of dishwashers over the years. This model was by far the easiest to install. Looking over different components and materials they used to build this made me appreciate the engineering that went into it. The plumbing & electrical are easy to access and the leveling system is top notch. For me this unit is a 5 of 5 ☆ I would certainly recommend this to others.

Sentence (English): We recently purchased this dishwasher to replace our 12-year-old Bosch and we're excited to experience the new features that didn't exist on our prior unit.
Comments (English): [ TRUE LOVE ] || ---------------- || We recently purchased this dishwasher to replace our 12-year-old Bosch and we're excited to experience the new features that didn't exist on our prior unit. We've been using it now for a month, and I find myself talking about this dishwasher and how much I love it to everyone I know. It is whisper-quiet as advertised, does an amazing job getting all of my toughest grimy dishes completely clean, and I love all of its features. You get that super slick and clean appearance from the outside without any of the clutter of LCD screens, yet we still get to see the cycle status because this model beams time/status onto the floor. The Crystal Dry feature isn't just a marketing gimmick. This feature is an absolute game-changer. As long as you have your items tilted so that water doesn't pool, all of your plastics will be completely dry. I love the LED lights that beam down and illuminate the dark areas of the dishwasher so that it is easier to see what you are doing. Lastly, I've come full circle on the silverware top drawer. I thought I was going to hate it, and it takes a minute to get accustomed to as you figure out what fits best in each slot, but it functions SOOO well, and gives you the space back for other items.My only complaint thus far which is minor, is that when my kids open the door after the cycle has started to put in a glass they had in their room and then close the door (which was how our previous dishwashers worked) the cycle pauses. You have to press the START button again any time the cycle is interrupted. I think each family member has done this at least once, and we've come down the next day only to find out that the cycle stopped and we still have 2 more hours for the cycle to finish.

Sentence (English): Dishwashers and dryers are said to be inconvenient to the point where they are inconvenient to not have once you use them!
Comments (English): Dishwashers and dryers are said to be inconvenient to the point where they are inconvenient to not have once you use them! Recently, I have been using dryers so conveniently that I thought it would be really inconvenient to not have one. However, dishwashers have become so good these days that I was just giving up because they are convenient and good, but I was so happy that I had this great opportunity! This dishwasher is a 12-person product. It is functional and the color is luxurious silver, so I think it matches the color of my sink. The color is neutral, so it would look good in any kitchen. When I looked into buying a dishwasher before, there were 6-person and 12-person dishwashers. I read an article about whether it is better to buy a 6-person or 12-person dishwasher if there are few people living in the house, but most people who have used a 6-person one unconditionally recommend a 12-person one regardless of the number of people in the house. When you open the door, just hold the middle handle and open it. You don't have to use a lot of force, which is nice. There are buttons to operate the dishwasher on the top of the handle. There is a power button and a button to select each course, so you can easily use it even if you know how to use the washing machine. The expected operating time is displayed in numbers in the middle, so it is very smart to use. When you open the door, the part you can see inside is the space for detergent and rinse. The 12-person capacity is spacious, and the upper and lower storage spaces inside make it enough for a family of four to use, and it can easily accommodate a 12-person frying pan and pot. It seems like it would be good to put mostly light items on the top. The inside is very large, so you can wash the pot you used to make shabu-shabu. You can wash the pot in the dishwasher. You really don't get your hands wet. These days, I always put the small pot I boiled ramen in the dishwasher. The wide and high bottom accommodates the cutting board, ramen pot, and soup pot. This dishwasher is really to my liking. There is also a spoon basket, including spoons, chopsticks, forks, and knives. It can even accommodate knives and scissors. And there was a bowl with cream on it after eating cake for a housewarming party. A greasy bowl that contained pork belly. A paper bowl with gochujang on it. A soju glass with fingerprints. I washed them all and it was great! My satisfaction is really increasing as I use it, and I understand why everyone calls it the new century aunt. There are people who have never used it, just like a dryer, but once you use it, it's an essential item you can't live without! The design and performance are both perfect, and I'm so, so satisfied. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

However, dishwashers have become so good these days that I was just giving up because they are convenient and good, but I was so happy that I had this great opportunity! This dishwasher is a 12-person product. It is functional and the color is luxurious silver, so I think it matches the color of my sink. The color is neutral, so it would look good in any kitchen. When I looked into buying a dishwasher before, there were 6-person and 12-person dishwashers. I read an article about whether it is better to buy a 6-person or 12-person dishwasher if there are few people living in the house, but most people who have used a 6-person one unconditionally recommend a 12-person one regardless of the number of people in the house. When you open the door, just hold the middle handle and open it. You don't have to use a lot of force, which is nice. There are buttons to operate the dishwasher on the top of the handle. There is a power button and a button to select each course, so you can easily use it even if you know how to use the washing machine. The expected operating time is displayed in numbers in the middle, so it is very smart to use. When you open the door, the part you can see inside is the space for detergent and rinse. The 12-person capacity is spacious, and the upper and lower storage spaces inside make it enough for a family of four to use, and it can easily accommodate a 12-person frying pan and pot. It seems like it would be good to put mostly light items on the top. The inside is very large, so you can wash the pot you used to make shabu-shabu. You can wash the pot in the dishwasher. You really don't get your hands wet. These days, I always put the small pot I boiled ramen in the dishwasher. The wide and high bottom accommodates the cutting board, ramen pot, and soup pot. This dishwasher is really to my liking. There is also a spoon basket, including spoons, chopsticks, forks, and knives. It can even accommodate knives and scissors. And there was a bowl with cream on it after eating cake for a housewarming party. A greasy bowl that contained pork belly. A paper bowl with gochujang on it. A soju glass with fingerprints. I washed them all and it was great! My satisfaction is really increasing as I use it, and I understand why everyone calls it the new century aunt. There are people who have never used it, just like a dryer, but once you use it, it's an essential item you can't live without! The design and performance are both perfect, and I'm so, so satisfied. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): Dishwashers and dryers are said to be inconvenient to the point where they are inconvenient to not have once you use them! Recently, I have been using dryers so conveniently that I thought it would be really inconvenient to not have one. However, dishwashers have become so good these days that I was just giving up because they are convenient and good, but I was so happy that I had this great opportunity! This dishwasher is a 12-person product. It is functional and the color is luxurious silver, so I think it matches the color of my sink. The color is neutral, so it would look good in any kitchen. When I looked into buying a dishwasher before, there were 6-person and 12-person dishwashers. I read an article about whether it is better to buy a 6-person or 12-person dishwasher if there are few people living in the house, but most people who have used a 6-person one unconditionally recommend a 12-person one regardless of the number of people in the house. When you open the door, just hold the middle handle and open it. You don't have to use a lot of force, which is nice. There are buttons to operate the dishwasher on the top of the handle. There is a power button and a button to select each course, so you can easily use it even if you know how to use the washing machine. The expected operating time is displayed in numbers in the middle, so it is very smart to use. When you open the door, the part you can see inside is the space for detergent and rinse. The 12-person capacity is spacious, and the upper and lower storage spaces inside make it enough for a family of four to use, and it can easily accommodate a 12-person frying pan and pot. It seems like it would be good to put mostly light items on the top. The inside is very large, so you can wash the pot you used to make shabu-shabu. You can wash the pot in the dishwasher. You really don't get your hands wet. These days, I always put the small pot I boiled ramen in the dishwasher. The wide and high bottom accommodates the cutting board, ramen pot, and soup pot. This dishwasher is really to my liking. There is also a spoon basket, including spoons, chopsticks, forks, and knives. It can even accommodate knives and scissors. And there was a bowl with cream on it after eating cake for a housewarming party. A greasy bowl that contained pork belly. A paper bowl with gochujang on it. A soju glass with fingerprints. I washed them all and it was great! My satisfaction is really increasing as I use it, and I understand why everyone calls it the new century aunt. There are people who have never used it, just like a dryer, but once you use it, it's an essential item you can't live without! The design and performance are both perfect, and I'm so, so satisfied. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): Dishwashers and dryers are said to be inconvenient to the point where they are inconvenient to not have once you use them! This dishwasher is a 12-person product. It is functional and the color is luxurious silver, so I think it matches the color of my sink. The color is neutral, so it would look good in any kitchen. When I looked into buying a dishwasher before, there were 6-person and 12-person dishwashers. I read an article about whether it is better to buy a 6-person or 12-person dishwasher if there are few people living in the house, but most people who have used a 6-person one unconditionally recommend a 12-person one regardless of the number of people in the house. When you open the door, just hold the middle handle and open it. You don't have to use a lot of force, which is nice. There are buttons to operate the dishwasher on the top of the handle. There is a power button and a button to select each course, so you can easily use it even if you know how to use the washing machine. The expected operating time is displayed in numbers in the middle, so it is very smart to use. When you open the door, the part you can see inside is the space for detergent and rinse. The 12-person capacity is spacious, and the upper and lower storage spaces inside make it enough for a family of four to use, and it can easily accommodate a 12-person frying pan and pot. It seems like it would be good to put mostly light items on the top. The inside is very large, so you can wash the pot you used to make shabu-shabu. You can wash the pot in the dishwasher. You really don't get your hands wet. These days, I always put the small pot I boiled ramen in the dishwasher. The wide and high bottom accommodates the cutting board, ramen pot, and soup pot. I finally bought a dishwasher, which is one of the essential appliances for newlyweds these days :) Since the 12-place model is difficult to install, I purchased the 6-place countertop model to sit right on the kitchen counter. Delivery: I purchased it on Coupang over the weekend, and since delivery was available starting Tuesday, I scheduled it for the earliest available date. Before delivery, I confirmed the schedule and time with the installer one more time and received delivery notifications via KakaoTalk. As expected from a major corporation, they are reliable in these aspects. Price: I searched several places to find the lowest price, and as expected, Coupang was the cheapest. Design: When buying appliances, my top priority isn't whether it's Samsung or LG, but design. Among the 6-place dishwashers, the Samsung Bespoke was the prettiest. LG isn't bad, but the price jumped significantly, so I excluded it from consideration. Installation: Two technicians visited, and since there was a hole in the countertop where a water purifier had been installed, the installation proceeded without any additional drilling. It took about 20 minutes. After installation, they kindly explained how to use it. As for performance... I tried running the dishwasher after grilling marinated pork neck for dinner last night. The grease from the meat was completely removed. You can see how spotlessly clean the frying pan is, right? Since we have a child, washing their water bottles every day used to be a hassle, but using the dishwasher made things so much easier! (You definitely need to check beforehand if your appliance is dishwasher-safe. I heard some models can get deformed.) It used to be exhausting standing for 30 minutes every evening doing the dishes, but now I'm free from dinner time. I really think it's worth getting appliances that others recommend. Sentence (English): Replaced and ancient dishwasher in the house we recently bought.
Comments (English): [ The claim is true! ] || ---------------- || Replaced and ancient dishwasher in the house we recently bought. As always, I review the appliance I'm shopping for six ways to Sunday. In this case, the evidence seemed to favor the Bosch 500 series dishwasher, specifically the SHP65CM5N. I don't know what all the letters mean, but I think the last one stands for "Nice! ". This thing is REALLY quiet. When researching it, I figured the red light projected onto the floor to tell you it's running was a gimmick. It's not. It's so quiet you might accidentally open it to put in the bowl and spoon from your evening snack. That light reminds you that it's on. The rack system is exceptionally well thought out, and the silverware rack at the top makes nesting of silverware virtually impossible, assuring that every item gets thoroughly clean, which it certainly does. Everything in the dishwasher gets cleaned well, and, like magic, when the door automatically opens at the end of a cycle, it's all dry, without the heat in other dishwashers that can melt your plastic items. This dishwasher is a gem. Don't make a mistake - get it.

Sentence (English): The installation was completed on Friday afternoon, and the installer was very attentive.
Comments (English): The installation was completed on Friday afternoon, and the installer was very attentive. I used it 5 times over the weekend. For a family of 3, I wash it after every meal, with bowls and cups on the upper shelf and plates and chopsticks on the lower shelf. The machine comes with 3 finish dishwashing beads, but unfortunately there is no funnel for adding soft water salt. Whether it is dishwashing beads or dishwashing powder, they are cleaner than washing by hand and save more water. If you want a brighter glass, then brightener is indispensable. In addition to using dishwashing beads for the first cleaning, I have to manually pour dishwashing powder and brightener several times, but I still don’t know the specific dosage or adding method. In experiment. As someone who is used to using dishwashers, 13 sets is of course more ideal. After all, the capacity is large and you can put it anywhere. However, if you cannot install 13 sets after moving, a desktop dishwasher is also a good choice, which can free your hands and allow you to spend more time with your children.

It is whisper-quiet as advertised, does an amazing job getting all of my toughest grimy dishes completely clean, and I love all of its features. My only complaint thus far which is minor, is that when my kids open the door after the cycle has started to put in a glass they had in their room and then close the door (which was how our previous dishwashers worked) the cycle pauses. You have to press the START button again any time the cycle is interrupted. I think each family member has done this at least once, and we've come down the next day only to find out that the cycle stopped and we still have 2 more hours for the cycle to finish.

Sentence (English): I'll start by saying this is my first Bosch appliance and I'm extremely happy with it so far.
Comments (English): [ Phenomenal & Quiet Machine so far ] || ---------------- || I'll start by saying this is my first Bosch appliance and I'm extremely happy with it so far. I'm going to break this down simply by 2 things: Looks & Functionality and installation. Looks & Operation: This machine has a sleek, smooth look with no face mounted controls. I went with the top control model and have really been impressed with the ease of use. The door feels solid and has a nice snappy feel when it opens & closes without being too hard for impaired or elderly people to use. The inside is designed well with the 3 rack for utensils and the multiple spray bar configuration seems to really make perfect coverage when washing. I bought it on 9/27/23 so it's been a month of use multiple times per week and ive yet to find a speck of anything stuck to a plate or fork. I'm very impressed with the overall operation. Almost forgot the best part, it's SILENT when running! The App is well thought out and functional. I use it to set a later time to start or to see how much tine is left on a cycle. Well done I happen to be an Electrician so I've installed plenty of dishwashers over the years. This model was by far the easiest to install. Looking over different components and materials they used to build this made me appreciate the engineering that went into it. The plumbing & electrical are easy to access and the leveling system is top notch. For me this unit is a 5 of 5 ☆ I would certainly recommend this to others.

Sentence (English): (This review was collected as part of a promotion.)
Comments (English): [ Excellent Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) I have had this dishwasher for a month, cleaning dishes for a hungry family of 5. Every dish gets clean every time, which is kind of the point. This happens with every detergent I've tried - and I had a few different ones kicking around because my old dishwasher was picky - with incredibly dirty dishes, and with any cycle including the Speed 60. It's great, and I have no regrets buying it. Some things Bosch could improve on - Crystal dry is very, very good. Plastic on the third rack does not get dry at all. The third rack is a *millimeter* too short to fit my lunch blox containers from my kids lunches, but they do fit as long as you push down on the rack a bit as you slide it in, it's only the seal around the door that gets in the way. This smart dishwasher forgoes a "delay start" button in favour of a "remote start" button. This is silly, I turned on remote start permanently so that button sits there useless and I do miss the delay start button. Why would you want to enable remote start only for one cycle? It makes no sense. Because I'm handy with these things, I fixed my missing delay start button by creating an automation with IFTTT that starts the selected cycle at midnight every night. So as long as the dishwasher is closed, and a detergent tablet loaded, dishes are clean every morning. Tip - if you are setting up this automation, you need to issue a command to turn on the dishwasher then issue another to start the selected cycle. Another option for bosch, would be to have the "Favourite cycle" integrate a selected start time, so I could press Favourite cycle and it would run the auto/crystal dry cycle on a delay start at midnight. I tried this, but the start time does not save with the favourite cycle's other settings. Hooking the dishwasher up to the "Home Connect" app is quite finicky, I found holding the start button to reset the dishwasher (which takes an eerily long time), then immeditely turning on the dishwasher, holding the remote start button to setup the pairing process, eventually successfully paired it and I haven't had any other issues with the home connect app since. Still, I dislike the separate apps for each manufacturer and hope that Bosch integrates Matter into their products quickly. Anyway, buy this dishwasher. If you don't need the smart features, buy the cheaper non-smart version with the delay start button intact. I like having my phone tell me when the dishwasher is done, and the solution I describe above has been working well for me for a few weeks.

Sentence (English): I have had this dishwasher for a month, cleaning dishes for a hungry family of 5.
Comments (English): [ Excellent Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I have had this dishwasher for a month, cleaning dishes for a hungry family of 5. Every dish gets clean every time, which is kind of the point. This happens with every detergent I've tried - and I had a few different ones kicking around because my old dishwasher was picky - with incredibly dirty dishes, and with any cycle including the Speed 60. It's great, and I have no regrets buying it.Some things Bosch could improve on -Crystal dry is very, very good. Plastic on the third rack does not get dry at all. The third rack is a *millimeter* too short to fit my lunch blox containers from my kids lunches, but they do fit as long as you push down on the rack a bit as you slide it in, it's only the seal around the door that gets in the way.This smart dishwasher forgoes a "delay start" button in favour of a "remote start" button. This is silly, I turned on remote start permanently so that button sits there useless and I do miss the delay start button. Why would you want to enable remote start only for one cycle? It makes no sense. Because I'm handy with these things, I fixed my missing delay start button by creating an automation with IFTTT that starts the selected cycle at midnight every night. So as long as the dishwasher is closed, and a detergent tablet loaded, dishes are clean every morning. Tip - if you are setting up this automation, you need to issue a command to turn on the dishwasher then issue another to start the selected cycle.Another option for bosch, would be to have the "Favourite cycle" integrate a selected start time, so I could press Favourite cycle and it would run the auto/crystal dry cycle on a delay start at midnight. I tried this, but the start time does not save with the favourite cycle's other settings.Hooking the dishwasher up to the "Home Connect" app is quite finicky, I found holding the start button to reset the dishwasher (which takes an eerily long time), then immeditely turning on the dishwasher, holding the remote start button to setup the pairing process, eventually successfully paired it and I haven't had any other issues with the home connect app since. Still, I dislike the separate apps for each manufacturer and hope that Bosch integrates Matter into their products quickly.Anyway, buy this dishwasher. If you don't need the smart features, buy the cheaper non-smart version with the delay start button intact. I like having my phone tell me when the dishwasher is done, and the solution I describe above has been working well for me for a few weeks.

I also like the filter arrangement, not a big deal to clean if necessary, where I had to unscrew and take pieces out of the old GE. So far, this unit has done everything we need it for very well.

Sentence (English): <My Own Purchase Review> After deciding to purchase a compact dishwasher to improve my quality of life while moving, I spent about a month researching and comparing various products.
Comments (English): [ I love it so much ] || ---------------- || <My Own Purchase Review> After deciding to purchase a compact dishwasher to improve my quality of life while moving, I spent about a month researching and comparing various products. First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) Reviews of the Minix said it was pretty, but the interior was smaller than expected, and that it was inconvenient to fill it with water every time. However, after actually purchasing and using it, I'm <<very.satisfied>>. You can fill the water tank at the bottom, but I installed it right next to the sink, so I remove the sink hose and fill it myself. There are rough protrusions on the bottom of the inlet, so if you pour water directly, there will be less leakage or splashing, and it will be fully replenished in 30 seconds. (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. I'd like to buy a dishwasher-specific cutlery holder, but I'm a little disappointed that there isn't one specifically for the Minix. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

(수압에 따라 다를수도 있어요. 저는 제일 세게 틀어놓고 보충합니다.)  기능은 표준, 강력, 쾌속, 절약, 내부세척, 저온 등이 있는데 저는 기본적으로 표준이나 강력으로 세척합니다. 세제는 미닉스 제품 말고 쿠팡에서 구매율이 높은것으로 사서 절반 잘라서 사용하는데 아주 세척 잘 돼요~  처음에 세척 후 건조시 자동문열림이 안되는것 같아 고장난 줄 알고 고객센터에 문의했었는데 (고장판명시 교체해줌)  영상으로 찍어 확인하니 세척이 끝나고 팬이 돌아가면서 바로 문이 열리는 것이 아니라 1차 팬이 돌아가다가  잠시 뒤 OPEN 되어 안에 있는 고온 김을 1차 분출하고 오염 방치차원으로 다시 문이 닫힌 상태로 팬이 계속 돌아가면서 건조가 되는 거였더라구요..  건조기 있으니 확실히 식사 후 바로 반려견과 산책을 다녀올수 있고 너무 좋습니다. ----------------------------------------------  약 한달 사용후기!!  처음에는 식기들을 트레이에 쌓는 일은 생각보다 어려워요. 하지만 일주일정도 지나다 보면 왠만히 쌓인 그릇들은 모두 트레이에 담아 한꺼번에 식기세척을 할 수 있게 되네요.ㅎ  다만 조리도구나 수저세트 등도 모아서 돌리다보니 2층 트레이에 모두 담기에 공간이 부족할때가 있어요. 식기세척기 전용 수저통이 있으면 구매하고 싶은데 미닉스 전용제품은 없어서 좀 아쉽네요. 식기세척기 한번 사용하기 시작하면 매번 설거지하던 그전으로 못 돌아갑니다.^^;;  --------------------------------------------  <추가후기>  보통 혼자 먹기 때문에 그릇 1,2개 & 수저 1세트가 모이고 모여 식기세척기를 돌리면  상단 트레이에 수저 놓을공간이 부족하여 타제품 수저통을 구해했어요.  음.. 보통 6인용, 12인용 수저통이라 3인용 미닉스에는 좀 버겁네요  한쪽에 그릇들을 세우고 수저통을 한쪽으로 배치하는데 높이가 거의 딱맞아 끝쪽으로 잘 배치해야 위쪽 프로펠러가 잘 돌아갑니다.  -------------------------------------------------  <추추가 후기>  22cm 냄비까지는 식기세척기 돌릴수 있으나 대신 같이 돌릴수 있는 그릇이 숫자는 줄어들게 됩니다. 저는 냄비1개, 아래 밥그릇, 국그릇, 접시 하니 약 5개 정도 넣고 돌리는 것 같습니다. 그릇이 조금만 크면 수저트레이는 올릴수가 없어서 수저트레이는 접시, 냄비가 없을때만 모아서 사용해요.  (타제품 수저통은 커서 잘 사용 안하게 되네요..)  그릇 테트리스는 1년이 지난 지금 처음보다 훨씬 더 많이 넣고 잘하게 됩니다. 세제는 개구리며 여러가지 써봤지만 자연퐁에서 나온게 훨씬 더 잘 맞는거 같네요. 세척은 무조건 2시간짜리 강력으로 돌리게 되네요~ㅎ  역시 지금까지도 만족하며 잘 사용중이에요~  .

Sentence (English): First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix.
Comments (English): [ I love it so much ] || ---------------- || <My Own Purchase Review> After deciding to purchase a compact dishwasher to improve my quality of life while moving, I spent about a month researching and comparing various products. First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) Reviews of the Minix said it was pretty, but the interior was smaller than expected, and that it was inconvenient to fill it with water every time. However, after actually purchasing and using it, I'm <<very.satisfied>>. You can fill the water tank at the bottom, but I installed it right next to the sink, so I remove the sink hose and fill it myself. There are rough protrusions on the bottom of the inlet, so if you pour water directly, there will be less leakage or splashing, and it will be fully replenished in 30 seconds. (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. I'd like to buy a dishwasher-specific cutlery holder, but I'm a little disappointed that there isn't one specifically for the Minix. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

Comments (English): [ I love it so much ] || ---------------- || <My Own Purchase Review> After deciding to purchase a compact dishwasher to improve my quality of life while moving, I spent about a month researching and comparing various products. First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) Reviews of the Minix said it was pretty, but the interior was smaller than expected, and that it was inconvenient to fill it with water every time. However, after actually purchasing and using it, I'm <<very.satisfied>>. You can fill the water tank at the bottom, but I installed it right next to the sink, so I remove the sink hose and fill it myself. There are rough protrusions on the bottom of the inlet, so if you pour water directly, there will be less leakage or splashing, and it will be fully replenished in 30 seconds. (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. I'd like to buy a dishwasher-specific cutlery holder, but I'm a little disappointed that there isn't one specifically for the Minix. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

Sentence (English): Reviews of the Minix said it was pretty, but the interior was smaller than expected, and that it was inconvenient to fill it with water every time.
Comments (English): [ I love it so much ] || ---------------- || <My Own Purchase Review> After deciding to purchase a compact dishwasher to improve my quality of life while moving, I spent about a month researching and comparing various products. First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) Reviews of the Minix said it was pretty, but the interior was smaller than expected, and that it was inconvenient to fill it with water every time. However, after actually purchasing and using it, I'm <<very.satisfied>>. You can fill the water tank at the bottom, but I installed it right next to the sink, so I remove the sink hose and fill it myself. There are rough protrusions on the bottom of the inlet, so if you pour water directly, there will be less leakage or splashing, and it will be fully replenished in 30 seconds. (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. I'd like to buy a dishwasher-specific cutlery holder, but I'm a little disappointed that there isn't one specifically for the Minix. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

Comments (English): [ I love it so much ] || ---------------- || <My Own Purchase Review> After deciding to purchase a compact dishwasher to improve my quality of life while moving, I spent about a month researching and comparing various products. First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) Reviews of the Minix said it was pretty, but the interior was smaller than expected, and that it was inconvenient to fill it with water every time. However, after actually purchasing and using it, I'm <<very.satisfied>>. You can fill the water tank at the bottom, but I installed it right next to the sink, so I remove the sink hose and fill it myself. There are rough protrusions on the bottom of the inlet, so if you pour water directly, there will be less leakage or splashing, and it will be fully replenished in 30 seconds. (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. I'd like to buy a dishwasher-specific cutlery holder, but I'm a little disappointed that there isn't one specifically for the Minix. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

Comments (English): [ I love it so much ] || ---------------- || <My Own Purchase Review> After deciding to purchase a compact dishwasher to improve my quality of life while moving, I spent about a month researching and comparing various products. First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) Reviews of the Minix said it was pretty, but the interior was smaller than expected, and that it was inconvenient to fill it with water every time. However, after actually purchasing and using it, I'm <<very.satisfied>>. You can fill the water tank at the bottom, but I installed it right next to the sink, so I remove the sink hose and fill it myself. There are rough protrusions on the bottom of the inlet, so if you pour water directly, there will be less leakage or splashing, and it will be fully replenished in 30 seconds. (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. I'd like to buy a dishwasher-specific cutlery holder, but I'm a little disappointed that there isn't one specifically for the Minix. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

Comments (English): [ I love it so much ] || ---------------- || <My Own Purchase Review> After deciding to purchase a compact dishwasher to improve my quality of life while moving, I spent about a month researching and comparing various products. First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) Reviews of the Minix said it was pretty, but the interior was smaller than expected, and that it was inconvenient to fill it with water every time. However, after actually purchasing and using it, I'm <<very.satisfied>>. You can fill the water tank at the bottom, but I installed it right next to the sink, so I remove the sink hose and fill it myself. There are rough protrusions on the bottom of the inlet, so if you pour water directly, there will be less leakage or splashing, and it will be fully replenished in 30 seconds. (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. I'd like to buy a dishwasher-specific cutlery holder, but I'm a little disappointed that there isn't one specifically for the Minix. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) However, after actually purchasing and using it, I'm <<very.satisfied>>. You can fill the water tank at the bottom, but I installed it right next to the sink, so I remove the sink hose and fill it myself. There are rough protrusions on the bottom of the inlet, so if you pour water directly, there will be less leakage or splashing, and it will be fully replenished in 30 seconds. (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. I'd like to buy a dishwasher-specific cutlery holder, but I'm a little disappointed that there isn't one specifically for the Minix. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

Sentence (English): Review after using it for about a month!
Comments (English): [ I love it so much ] || ---------------- || <My Own Purchase Review> After deciding to purchase a compact dishwasher to improve my quality of life while moving, I spent about a month researching and comparing various products. First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) Reviews of the Minix said it was pretty, but the interior was smaller than expected, and that it was inconvenient to fill it with water every time. However, after actually purchasing and using it, I'm <<very.satisfied>>. You can fill the water tank at the bottom, but I installed it right next to the sink, so I remove the sink hose and fill it myself. There are rough protrusions on the bottom of the inlet, so if you pour water directly, there will be less leakage or splashing, and it will be fully replenished in 30 seconds. (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. I'd like to buy a dishwasher-specific cutlery holder, but I'm a little disappointed that there isn't one specifically for the Minix. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. Sentence (English): Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time.
Comments (English): [ I love it so much ] || ---------------- || <My Own Purchase Review> After deciding to purchase a compact dishwasher to improve my quality of life while moving, I spent about a month researching and comparing various products. First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) Reviews of the Minix said it was pretty, but the interior was smaller than expected, and that it was inconvenient to fill it with water every time. However, after actually purchasing and using it, I'm <<very.satisfied>>. You can fill the water tank at the bottom, but I installed it right next to the sink, so I remove the sink hose and fill it myself. There are rough protrusions on the bottom of the inlet, so if you pour water directly, there will be less leakage or splashing, and it will be fully replenished in 30 seconds. (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. I'd like to buy a dishwasher-specific cutlery holder, but I'm a little disappointed that there isn't one specifically for the Minix. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .
