Comments (English): [ I love it so much ] || ---------------- || <My Own Purchase Review> After deciding to purchase a compact dishwasher to improve my quality of life while moving, I spent about a month researching and comparing various products. First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) Reviews of the Minix said it was pretty, but the interior was smaller than expected, and that it was inconvenient to fill it with water every time. However, after actually purchasing and using it, I'm <<very.satisfied>>. You can fill the water tank at the bottom, but I installed it right next to the sink, so I remove the sink hose and fill it myself. There are rough protrusions on the bottom of the inlet, so if you pour water directly, there will be less leakage or splashing, and it will be fully replenished in 30 seconds. (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. I'd like to buy a dishwasher-specific cutlery holder, but I'm a little disappointed that there isn't one specifically for the Minix. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

Comments (English): [ I love it so much ] || ---------------- || <My Own Purchase Review> After deciding to purchase a compact dishwasher to improve my quality of life while moving, I spent about a month researching and comparing various products. First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) There are rough protrusions on the bottom of the inlet, so if you pour water directly, there will be less leakage or splashing, and it will be fully replenished in 30 seconds. (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. I'd like to buy a dishwasher-specific cutlery holder, but I'm a little disappointed that there isn't one specifically for the Minix. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! Comments (English): [ I love it so much ] || ---------------- || <My Own Purchase Review> After deciding to purchase a compact dishwasher to improve my quality of life while moving, I spent about a month researching and comparing various products. First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) Reviews of the Minix said it was pretty, but the interior was smaller than expected, and that it was inconvenient to fill it with water every time. However, after actually purchasing and using it, I'm <<very.satisfied>>. You can fill the water tank at the bottom, but I installed it right next to the sink, so I remove the sink hose and fill it myself. There are rough protrusions on the bottom of the inlet, so if you pour water directly, there will be less leakage or splashing, and it will be fully replenished in 30 seconds. (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. I'd like to buy a dishwasher-specific cutlery holder, but I'm a little disappointed that there isn't one specifically for the Minix. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

Comments (English): [ I love it so much ] || ---------------- || <My Own Purchase Review> After deciding to purchase a compact dishwasher to improve my quality of life while moving, I spent about a month researching and comparing various products. First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) However, after actually purchasing and using it, I'm <<very.satisfied>>. You can fill the water tank at the bottom, but I installed it right next to the sink, so I remove the sink hose and fill it myself. There are rough protrusions on the bottom of the inlet, so if you pour water directly, there will be less leakage or splashing, and it will be fully replenished in 30 seconds. (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. I'd like to buy a dishwasher-specific cutlery holder, but I'm a little disappointed that there isn't one specifically for the Minix. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

Comments (English): [ I love it so much ] || ---------------- || <My Own Purchase Review> After deciding to purchase a compact dishwasher to improve my quality of life while moving, I spent about a month researching and comparing various products. First, I looked for a product that could be installed without a drill, and there were several options besides the Minix. After searching various reviews on YouTube and other platforms, I found that the Minix was the only one with an "auto door open" feature. I was literally buying it to improve my quality of life, but I couldn't just wait at home and open the door every time the dishwasher finished its cycle. (They say that if it doesn't have an auto door open feature, it can smell like water.) Reviews of the Minix said it was pretty, but the interior was smaller than expected, and that it was inconvenient to fill it with water every time. However, after actually purchasing and using it, I'm <<very.satisfied>>. You can fill the water tank at the bottom, but I installed it right next to the sink, so I remove the sink hose and fill it myself. There are rough protrusions on the bottom of the inlet, so if you pour water directly, there will be less leakage or splashing, and it will be fully replenished in 30 seconds. (This may vary depending on the water pressure. I turn it on the highest setting and refill.) The functions include standard, strong, quick, economical, interior wash, and low temperature, and I usually wash on standard or strong. I don't use Minix products, but I bought a detergent with a high purchase rate on Coupang, cut it in half, and it washes very well. At first, the automatic door didn't seem to open after washing and drying, so I thought it was broken and contacted the customer service center (they will replace it if it is determined to be broken). When I checked with a video, I saw that after washing, the fan doesn't turn on and the door doesn't open right away. Instead, the fan turns on first, then opens for a while to blow out the high-temperature steam inside, and then the door closes again to prevent contamination, and the fan continues to turn while drying. Since there is a dryer, I can definitely go for a walk with my dog right after eating, and it's so nice. ---------------------------------------------- Review after using it for about a month! At first, stacking dishes on the tray is harder than you might think. But after about a week, you can put most of the dishes that have piled up on the tray and wash them all at once. However, since I also collect and run cooking utensils and cutlery sets, there are times when the second-tier tray doesn't have enough space to hold everything. I'd like to buy a dishwasher-specific cutlery holder, but I'm a little disappointed that there isn't one specifically for the Minix. Once you start using a dishwasher, you'll never go back to washing dishes every time. ^^;; -------------------------------------------- <Additional Review> Since I usually eat alone, I only have one or two dishes and one set of cutlery, so when I run the dishwasher with them, there's not enough space on the top tray for cutlery, so I had to buy a different cutlery holder. Um. Usually, cutlery holders are for 6 or 12 people, so it's a bit too much for the 3-person Minix. I place the dishes on one side and the cutlery holder on the other side. The height is just right, so I have to place it at the end so that the upper propeller turns smoothly. ------------------------------------------------- <Additional review> You can put a pot up to 22cm in the dishwasher, but the number of dishes that can be washed at the same time decreases. I put in about 5 dishes: 1 pot, a rice bowl, a soup bowl, and a plate. If the bowl is just a little bigger, the cutlery tray cannot be put up, so I only use the cutlery tray when there are no plates or pots. (I don't use the cutlery holders of other products because they are big.) Now, after a year, I can put in a lot more dishes and do the dish Tetris better than before. I've tried various detergents, including Frog, but the one from Jayeon Pong seems to work much better. I always wash it on the strong cycle for 2 hours~ As expected, I'm still satisfied and using it well~ .

Sentence (English): I was using a 6-seater dishwasher without installation, but when I moved, I upgraded to a 12-seater.
Comments (English): [ I like the dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I was using a 6-seater dishwasher without installation, but when I moved, I upgraded to a 12-seater. I asked the installer what a built-in dishwasher meant, and he said it means the dishwasher is placed inside the lower cabinet. Some dishwashers can be installed as a standalone unit, but built-in ones can't. We were planning to install it in the lower cabinet anyway, but the size didn't fit, so they came twice to remodel. Because of this, it took about a week after we moved in to install the dishwasher, which was a bit disappointing. It took several more days between the remodel and the installation. This unit has three tiers. The top tier is for utensils, thin spatulas, and the bottom tier has a separate cutlery holder. The lower tier is removable, so you can take it out when not in use, but it hasn't been full yet, so we just leave it in and let it run. It's not a self-drying unit, but it does dry naturally with hot steam and I think it's capable of sterilizing. The dishwasher says a light will light up when it's time to clean the interior. The installer seemed to assume we had no experience with dishwashers, so he gave us a very basic explanation and attitude, which allowed us to ask questions. I knew the app wouldn't work when I purchased it, but I haven't felt the need for it yet. I used to use a 6-person dishwasher, but now I'm using a 12-person dishwasher, and it feels like too much space, so it's a bit of a waste, but I don't have to play Tetris anymore, which is great. I don't run the dishwasher once a day; I run it once in the morning and once in the afternoon after dinner. One drawback of this product is that you can't run it only on the top or bottom. Comments (English): [ #Dishwasher is #LG #Coupang ] || ---------------- || I purchased the LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher, a 12-seater Nature Beige DUBJ4EL with hot air dryer and built-in dryer. I used it over 60 times from summer to fall and am writing this review. One day, I was putting the dishwasher away, wondering what to buy and what would be the best option. I accidentally paid for the basic model, which cost around 600,000 won. "Honey! I paid for it! What the heck!" Moving and the cost of a new home were high, so buying a dishwasher was out of the question. My husband kept telling me, "Buy it! Buy it now! Buy it now!" I debated whether to buy my old one, but immediately canceled. Thinking, "Since I'm going to buy it anyway, I might as well have a little something," I decided to buy the DUBJ4EL. A dishwasher is an appliance that gives me such satisfaction that it makes any worries seem pointless. All the time, effort, and anxiety I've put into washing dishes have been insignificant. The machine does it better than I can by hand. My happiness level has gone up since I got a dishwasher. I can spend a little more time cooking and make delicious food, and the machine does the dishes, so it requires less labor and energy. Incidentally, I pre-wash the dishes properly because I want to clean the drain filter less often. My husband is so happy with this dishwasher that he's applauding it. It's a kitchen appliance the whole family uses. Let's compare the specs below. The model I purchased is the DUBJ4EL. DUB stands for built-under (kitchen fit), J4 stands for objet d'art with steam and hot air drying, E stands for nature beige, and L stands for a foldable basket at the very bottom, no frying pan flower, and the washing blades are plastic. The differences compared to the higher-end models are that only the top (spoon) is decorated with steel, there's no handle decoration at the middle bottom (the front is plastic), and there's no side rack (frying pan holder). Let me explain the model at the very back. L is a partially folding shelf at the very bottom, and the washing wing is not decorated with stainless steel (this is the one I recently purchased). H is a fully folding shelf, and the washing wing decoration is OK. S is a fully folding shelf, with stainless steel decoration, and a frying pan holder is OK. I'm sure you're really worried about the DUBJ1EP model sold on Coupang, which is a lower model than this one ~~~ I've only listed the missing parts. The lower model has an LED for the progress status and a front touch button for the operation. This model does not have 100-degree Celsius true steam or hot air drying. There are no convenience features such as a front time display, remaining time display, pause, antibacterial handle, or air filter. Up appliances (app linkage, home appliance diagnosis improvement, function addition, display change, etc.) are not available, and there is no multipurpose shelf (for placing spoons, ladles, small cups, lids, etc.). It has an automatic door opening and high-temperature drying, but there is no hot air drying, condensation/latent heat, circulation, or single drying. There is no night/low-noise internal washing in the course. Instead of high-temperature sterilization, there's a "Bulge" option. There's no "100% True Steam" option, and instead of a steam sterilization tank, there's a "Bulge" option. I compared the higher-end and lower-end models. On Coupang, I think the DUBJ4EL model is the best choice! *Purchase Tips* *Usage Tips*. Compare features and prices carefully, purchase with a credit card discount, and I hope you're very satisfied! The installer told me to try it out and use salt and conditioner, but I didn't need to use either. I live in a new apartment, so I wonder if the water is okay~~ If I don't use conditioner, the silicone material leaves white spots, but I don't mind at all. I put in wooden spoons and chopsticks and spin it. The tumbler doesn't peel off either. The gold leaf doesn't come off either. However, thinly printed items tend to peel off slightly. Since I bought this appliance for my own comfort, I throw most of my stuff in the dishwasher. When I use it in the middle of summer with the air conditioner on, the sudden temperature difference when the automatic door opens and steam escapes causes water droplets to form around the area, but this is normal. I was worried at first, but it was because the air conditioner temperature was too low. Enjoy a fun kitchen life with LG dishwasher kitchen appliances! H is a fully folding shelf, and the washing wing decoration is OK. S is a fully folding shelf, with stainless steel decoration, and a frying pan holder is OK. I'm sure you're really worried about the DUBJ1EP model sold on Coupang, which is a lower model than this one ~~~ I've only listed the missing parts. The lower model has an LED for the progress status and a front touch button for the operation. This model does not have 100-degree Celsius true steam or hot air drying. There are no convenience features such as a front time display, remaining time display, pause, antibacterial handle, or air filter. Up appliances (app linkage, home appliance diagnosis improvement, function addition, display change, etc.) are not available, and there is no multipurpose shelf (for placing spoons, ladles, small cups, lids, etc.). Sentence (English): Replacing Mom's dishwasher while in town visiting her.
Comments (English): [ A successful home improvement project. ] || ---------------- || Replacing Mom's dishwasher while in town visiting her. I was able to order the dishwasher on Costco.com and make arrangements to have it delivered when I was going to be there. The Costco delivery scheduling worked great. I received a steady stream of updates regarding the status of the delivery right up to when the truck arrived. I had removed the old dishwasher before the truck arrived. The delivery team brought the new unit directly into the kitchen for me. They hauled away the old unit. Costco.com rocks! The Bosch 300 series SHE53U75 dishwasher was easy to install. Bosch has simplified the routing of the water supply and drain lines. Both lines are located at the rear of the dishwasher, eliminating the need to route a water line to a front connection. This really speeds up the installation. It also makes the unit very easy to install for a handy homeowner. The operation of the Bosch SHE53U75 is very quiet. The dishes come out clean and dry. On the SHE53U75 model, Bosch has added an interesting feature. In order to combat mineral build up due to hard water, the dishwasher comes with a built in water softener. You can test the PH of your water and program the dishwasher to soften the dish water based on your water's PH. The dishwasher has a separate dispenser for softener salt built in. (salt sold separately) The water softener can be shut off or via the control panel. Those Germans are clever! Overall, Mom is very happy with her new dishwasher.

Sentence (English): This is the best dishwasher we've ever owned.
Comments (English): [ Good on ya', KitchenAid! ] || ---------------- || This is the best dishwasher we've ever owned. The only reason I didn't assign five stars is the sensitivity and placement of the control buttons on top of the door. When closing the door, my hand often touches a sensitive button to start a cycle I didn't intend to start; not a big deal as long as I notice the unintended button-push and press “Cancel.” The overarching reason we really like this machine and would buy it again is the ability to change sizes and shapes of the three racks to accommodate everything we wash: 1. The shallow upper third rack is great not only for regular tea and coffee cups, but also all the little incidental items we once washed by hand because they took up too much “rack space” needed for bigger items in the old two rack machine; 2. Since the middle rack can be moved up and down, I can make plenty of height-space in the lower rack for huge items like tall mixer bowls, a big porcelain bread bread storage box, etc.; 3. I've been surprised how much I like the ability to either “recline” or slide some of the tines on the middle and bottom racks; this allows me to make spaces custom fit for bowls, for example, so they aren't falling into each other but stand up not touching each other during the whole wash cycle; this feature also makes it possible to customize spaces for the oddly shaped basket and basket holder from the coffee maker which allows me to angle those odd pieces so they don't pool more rinse water than the drying cycle can evaporate (since learning this, I haven't had to hand dry anything like I did with the old machine; also, this machine lets me add 15 minutes drying time if it looks like some item is going to be a pool-catcher and need more drying time. Lastly, the capacity of this machine is large enough that the two of us only need to run it every three or four days and it is so quiet we let it run while we watch television in the evening. So, yes, this dishwasher is exceeding our expectations in almost every way. I almost added the fifth star, but having to cancel my unintended button pushes is a frequent occurrence, which is minor in comparison to all the new advantages of this machine. We would buy this machine again if we had reason to move to another house. Good on ya, KitchenAid!

Other than that, install straight forward. It would be nice if they made it easier to adjust the height. Once installed, the machine is very large. Especially if you take out the trays for silverware which fits nicely in the third rack. The machine is exceptionally quiet with exception to the draining which is fine. Since the controls are all hidden, there is a red light shining on the floor indicating the device is in use. It would be nice if a green light were shown when the wash was complete. Regardless of mode being used, I always clean off all debris before placing it inside the dishwasher (just less for me to clean off the bottom later). It does a great job of cleaning. I'm not impressed with its ability to drive, even with the door opening itself.

Sentence (English): I have had my GE dishwasher for a few weeks now.
Comments (English): [ Nice machine, Bad rack design. ] || ---------------- || I have had my GE dishwasher for a few weeks now. It seems O.K and cleans the dishes well on the sensor setting. It also dries them well on the lower power boost setting.The things I don't like are the racks. There is no place to set my cereal bolls in the upright position. The tines are too close together. Also there is a lot of space between the lower and 2nd rack. This put the 2nd rack too close to the 3rd rack for my "Big Gulp" cups. This makes the large bottle water jets kind of "useless" (nice Idea though). The 3 rack is a bit too short to fit the cereal bolls in without hitting the inside top of the dishwasher. It's a big machine but the rack design makes it impossible to go more than a day without running it.Finally on the installation: The drain tube connection was a bit oversized. I had to put a big clamp on it to get it to seal.

Sentence (English): I installed it after checking that the manufacturing date was within the past 3 months, and I've used it more than 10 times without any problems.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher that doesn't require larval cleaning ] || ---------------- || I installed it after checking that the manufacturing date was within the past 3 months, and I've used it more than 10 times without any problems. There's a lot of moisture left after using the standard mode, but if you leave it for a few hours with the door open, it dries, so I don't really care. I don't do the pre-washing like others, but I just remove the large pieces and run it. I also put the egg custard pot that got stuck as is, and both are cleaned very, very well. I cut the Prosh in half and use it, and when I'm grilling pork belly, making curry, kimchi stew, or making red soup, I use the strong mode + strong drying + use an entire Prosh that I haven't cut. Even if Tetris is a little awkward, the moisture is completely removed. There's no white powder or detergent residue. Don't be too stingy with detergent, and if you're going to run it, put it in boldly so that it gets clean. Besides that, half a pack is enough for the dishes that come out after a regular meal. There is ample storage space, so Tetris is not a problem, and a 26cm or 28cm frying pan fits well. I hope I can use it for a long time without any problems. I like it better because the color is not bright, but closer to gray than white.

Sentence (English): I don't usually write reviews, but I'm leaving an honest review.
Comments (English): [ I'm using it well ] || ---------------- || I don't usually write reviews, but I'm leaving an honest review. My wrists hurt so much that I was looking around for a dishwasher, but I saw some good reviews and bought one. First of all, my kitchen is so small that I couldn't even think about a built-in type, and I hesitated for over a year because I heard that if I bought a small one, the low volume ratio would lower my satisfaction. The Chefborn product has the highest volume ratio among compact dishwashers, and the water supply pipe can be used through the water tank outside, and it's very easy to install. I saw someone else's review saying that the humming noise gave them a headache, and I felt the same way. Since I live in an apartment, I separately purchased and laid down a noise-cancelling mat on the lower floor to reduce the noise between floors. The humming noise was greatly reduced, and it doesn't bother me much even if I'm next to it. It doesn't load a lot of dishes at once, but it handles enough dishes for four people. Someone else said that their quality of life has skyrocketed, but washing dishes is secretly stressful. It seems to have relieved some of that stress. At first, I used the quick mode a few times, but when I switched to the standard mode, the dishes were washed better. It does wipe cleanly. When drying, if you leave the door open and run it for 20 minutes during this season, it will dry quickly. The only downside is that you can't use the drying function separately. I left a few words for those who are hesitating to buy a dishwasher.

Comments (English): I went to the store to look at several products and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after thinking about it a bit more, I bought this one when it came up on Coupang. I am satisfied with the size inside. When you manually open the door, it stays in place as much as you lower it. You can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when you let go of it at 80 degrees. I love details like this. I am especially satisfied with the function that the door opens after washing. Rinse? I will not use this because it says that the door does not open if you only use the rinse function. The technician kindly informed me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, grains of rice and such can get rotting and start a cafeteria smell. Oh, I learned something new today. You can remove the strainer by holding the blue one and turning it. I also like how simple the program button is. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use, but the owner told me that the height of the upper basket inside is adjustable. The spoon basket also has a handle, which is nice. With the S or L models, you have to lay the spoons in the large basket on top to wash them, but this one has a separate, smaller basket, so it will be convenient to wash the spoons and move them to the spoon holder. The technician explained it well, so do I really need an instruction manual? I want to. But just in case, I have the manual. I'll write about the product. Disadvantages: For me who has difficulty deciding, I bought it without hesitation because it was only one color, but for those who like colorful things, there might be a disadvantage because there is no choice of color. Advantages: 1. Ample storage (I went to the store and looked at several major companies' products, and a new 14-person model was released. In my opinion, and with the naked eye, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in internal space.) 2. Door opening function after washing (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it's not this product. For reference, this product says the door doesn't open when using function 7.) 3. The menu pops up right away when reusing (After the test run, the power turns off automatically, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before pops up. It's so convenient for me who always uses only one function. It can raise my laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly and looked at the dishwasher. The technician also said that Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation and friendly technician I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was so friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first, and he told me not to empty the drawer or the bottom of the sink himself. The location of the drain in my house is weird, so I chose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and then installed it again. After putting it in, he cleaned it up after it was done, took the product box, and kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product was brought in. I told him that I purposely moved in without installing the flooring, but he moved it very carefully. Several installers have come, and although they have been late for more than an hour, or at least a few minutes, there has never been anyone like this. He came earlier than the appointment time, and when I told him that I was going out, he calmly said that he would wait. Sentence (English): I am satisfied with the size inside.
Comments (English): I went to the store to look at several products and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after thinking about it a bit more, I bought this one when it came up on Coupang. With the S or L models, you have to lay the spoons in the large basket on top to wash them, but this one has a separate, smaller basket, so it will be convenient to wash the spoons and move them to the spoon holder. Advantages: 1. Ample storage (I went to the store and looked at several major companies' products, and a new 14-person model was released. In my opinion, and with the naked eye, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in internal space.) 2. Door opening function after washing (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it's not this product. For reference, this product says the door doesn't open when using function 7.) 3. But now that I've washed the dishes, I can't find the cutlery. It's so convenient to move it here.) 4. The menu pops up right away when reusing (After the test run, the power turns off automatically, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before pops up. It's so convenient for me who always uses only one function. It can raise my laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly and looked at the dishwasher. The technician also said that Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation and friendly technician I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was so friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first, and he told me not to empty the drawer or the bottom of the sink himself. The location of the drain in my house is weird, so I chose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and then installed it again. After putting it in, he cleaned it up after it was done, took the product box, and kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product was brought in. I told him that I purposely moved in without installing the flooring, but he moved it very carefully. Several installers have come, and although they have been late for more than an hour, or at least a few minutes, there has never been anyone like this. He came earlier than the appointment time, and when I told him that I was going out, he calmly said that he would wait. When I got there, he had already put the product up while he was waiting, and he had parked his car again so as not to disturb other cars. I think this person is someone who succeeds at whatever he does. Anyway, I am completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): You can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when you let go of it at 80 degrees.
Comments (English): I went to the store to look at several products and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after thinking about it a bit more, I bought this one when it came up on Coupang. The technician kindly informed me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, grains of rice and such can get rotting and start a cafeteria smell. Oh, I learned something new today. You can remove the strainer by holding the blue one and turning it. I also like how simple the program button is. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use, but the owner told me that the height of the upper basket inside is adjustable. The spoon basket also has a handle, which is nice. With the S or L models, you have to lay the spoons in the large basket on top to wash them, but this one has a separate, smaller basket, so it will be convenient to wash the spoons and move them to the spoon holder. The technician explained it well, so do I really need an instruction manual? I want to. But just in case, I have the manual. I'll write about the product. Disadvantages: For me who has difficulty deciding, I bought it without hesitation because it was only one color, but for those who like colorful things, there might be a disadvantage because there is no choice of color. Advantages: 1. Ample storage (I went to the store and looked at several major companies' products, and a new 14-person model was released. In my opinion, and with the naked eye, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in internal space.) 2. Door opening function after washing (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it's not this product. For reference, this product says the door doesn't open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with handle (The products of major companies don't have this, but there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But now that I've washed the dishes, I can't find the cutlery. It's so convenient to move it here.) 4. The menu pops up right away when reusing (After the test run, the power turns off automatically, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before pops up. It's so convenient for me who always uses only one function. It can raise my laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly and looked at the dishwasher. The technician also said that Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation and friendly technician I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was so friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first, and he told me not to empty the drawer or the bottom of the sink himself. The location of the drain in my house is weird, so I chose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and then installed it again. After putting it in, he cleaned it up after it was done, took the product box, and kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product was brought in. I told him that I purposely moved in without installing the flooring, but he moved it very carefully. Several installers have come, and although they have been late for more than an hour, or at least a few minutes, there has never been anyone like this. He came earlier than the appointment time, and when I told him that I was going out, he calmly said that he would wait. When I got there, he had already put the product up while he was waiting, and he had parked his car again so as not to disturb other cars. I think this person is someone who succeeds at whatever he does. Anyway, I am completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): I am especially satisfied with the function that the door opens after washing.
Comments (English): I went to the store to look at several products and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after thinking about it a bit more, I bought this one when it came up on Coupang. I am satisfied with the size inside. When you manually open the door, it stays in place as much as you lower it. You can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when you let go of it at 80 degrees. I love details like this. I am especially satisfied with the function that the door opens after washing. Rinse? I will not use this because it says that the door does not open if you only use the rinse function. The technician kindly informed me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, grains of rice and such can get rotting and start a cafeteria smell. Oh, I learned something new today. You can remove the strainer by holding the blue one and turning it. I also like how simple the program button is. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use, but the owner told me that the height of the upper basket inside is adjustable. The spoon basket also has a handle, which is nice. With the S or L models, you have to lay the spoons in the large basket on top to wash them, but this one has a separate, smaller basket, so it will be convenient to wash the spoons and move them to the spoon holder. The technician explained it well, so do I really need an instruction manual? I want to. But just in case, I have the manual. I'll write about the product. Disadvantages: For me who has difficulty deciding, I bought it without hesitation because it was only one color, but for those who like colorful things, there might be a disadvantage because there is no choice of color. Advantages: 1. Ample storage (I went to the store and looked at several major companies' products, and a new 14-person model was released. In my opinion, and with the naked eye, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in internal space.) 2. Door opening function after washing (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it's not this product. For reference, this product says the door doesn't open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with handle (The products of major companies don't have this, but there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But now that I've washed the dishes, I can't find the cutlery. It's so convenient to move it here.) 4. The menu pops up right away when reusing (After the test run, the power turns off automatically, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before pops up. It's so convenient for me who always uses only one function. It can raise my laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly and looked at the dishwasher. The technician also said that Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation and friendly technician I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was so friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first, and he told me not to empty the drawer or the bottom of the sink himself. The location of the drain in my house is weird, so I chose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and then installed it again. After putting it in, he cleaned it up after it was done, took the product box, and kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product was brought in. I told him that I purposely moved in without installing the flooring, but he moved it very carefully. Several installers have come, and although they have been late for more than an hour, or at least a few minutes, there has never been anyone like this. He came earlier than the appointment time, and when I told him that I was going out, he calmly said that he would wait. When I got there, he had already put the product up while he was waiting, and he had parked his car again so as not to disturb other cars. I think this person is someone who succeeds at whatever he does. Anyway, I am completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): You can remove the strainer by holding the blue one and turning it.
Comments (English): I went to the store to look at several products and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after thinking about it a bit more, I bought this one when it came up on Coupang. I am satisfied with the size inside. When you manually open the door, it stays in place as much as you lower it. You can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when you let go of it at 80 degrees. I love details like this. I am especially satisfied with the function that the door opens after washing. Rinse? I will not use this because it says that the door does not open if you only use the rinse function. The technician kindly informed me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, grains of rice and such can get rotting and start a cafeteria smell. Oh, I learned something new today. You can remove the strainer by holding the blue one and turning it. I also like how simple the program button is. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use, but the owner told me that the height of the upper basket inside is adjustable. The spoon basket also has a handle, which is nice. With the S or L models, you have to lay the spoons in the large basket on top to wash them, but this one has a separate, smaller basket, so it will be convenient to wash the spoons and move them to the spoon holder. The technician explained it well, so do I really need an instruction manual? I want to. But just in case, I have the manual. I'll write about the product. Disadvantages: For me who has difficulty deciding, I bought it without hesitation because it was only one color, but for those who like colorful things, there might be a disadvantage because there is no choice of color. Advantages: 1. Ample storage (I went to the store and looked at several major companies' products, and a new 14-person model was released. In my opinion, and with the naked eye, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in internal space.) 2. Door opening function after washing (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it's not this product. For reference, this product says the door doesn't open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with handle (The products of major companies don't have this, but there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But now that I've washed the dishes, I can't find the cutlery. It's so convenient to move it here.) 4. The menu pops up right away when reusing (After the test run, the power turns off automatically, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before pops up. It's so convenient for me who always uses only one function. It can raise my laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly and looked at the dishwasher. The technician also said that Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation and friendly technician I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was so friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first, and he told me not to empty the drawer or the bottom of the sink himself. The location of the drain in my house is weird, so I chose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and then installed it again. After putting it in, he cleaned it up after it was done, took the product box, and kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product was brought in. I told him that I purposely moved in without installing the flooring, but he moved it very carefully. Several installers have come, and although they have been late for more than an hour, or at least a few minutes, there has never been anyone like this. He came earlier than the appointment time, and when I told him that I was going out, he calmly said that he would wait. When I got there, he had already put the product up while he was waiting, and he had parked his car again so as not to disturb other cars. I think this person is someone who succeeds at whatever he does. Anyway, I am completely satisfied with this product and service.

In my opinion, and with the naked eye, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in internal space.) 2. Door opening function after washing (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. I think this person is someone who succeeds at whatever he does. Anyway, I am completely satisfied with this product and service.

Comments (English): I went to the store to look at several products and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after thinking about it a bit more, I bought this one when it came up on Coupang. In my opinion, and with the naked eye, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in internal space.) 2. Door opening function after washing (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. Professional installation and friendly technician I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was so friendly. When I got there, he had already put the product up while he was waiting, and he had parked his car again so as not to disturb other cars. I think this person is someone who succeeds at whatever he does. Anyway, I am completely satisfied with this product and service.

Comments (English): I went to the store to look at several products and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after thinking about it a bit more, I bought this one when it came up on Coupang. I am especially satisfied with the function that the door opens after washing. Rinse? I will not use this because it says that the door does not open if you only use the rinse function. The technician kindly informed me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, grains of rice and such can get rotting and start a cafeteria smell. Oh, I learned something new today. You can remove the strainer by holding the blue one and turning it. I also like how simple the program button is. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use, but the owner told me that the height of the upper basket inside is adjustable. The spoon basket also has a handle, which is nice. With the S or L models, you have to lay the spoons in the large basket on top to wash them, but this one has a separate, smaller basket, so it will be convenient to wash the spoons and move them to the spoon holder. The technician explained it well, so do I really need an instruction manual? I want to. But just in case, I have the manual. I'll write about the product. Disadvantages: For me who has difficulty deciding, I bought it without hesitation because it was only one color, but for those who like colorful things, there might be a disadvantage because there is no choice of color. Advantages: 1. Ample storage (I went to the store and looked at several major companies' products, and a new 14-person model was released. In my opinion, and with the naked eye, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in internal space.) 2. Door opening function after washing (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it's not this product. For reference, this product says the door doesn't open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with handle (The products of major companies don't have this, but there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But now that I've washed the dishes, I can't find the cutlery. It's so convenient to move it here.) 4. The menu pops up right away when reusing (After the test run, the power turns off automatically, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before pops up. It's so convenient for me who always uses only one function. It can raise my laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly and looked at the dishwasher. The technician also said that Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation and friendly technician I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was so friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first, and he told me not to empty the drawer or the bottom of the sink himself. The location of the drain in my house is weird, so I chose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and then installed it again. After putting it in, he cleaned it up after it was done, took the product box, and kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product was brought in. I told him that I purposely moved in without installing the flooring, but he moved it very carefully. Several installers have come, and although they have been late for more than an hour, or at least a few minutes, there has never been anyone like this. He came earlier than the appointment time, and when I told him that I was going out, he calmly said that he would wait. When I got there, he had already put the product up while he was waiting, and he had parked his car again so as not to disturb other cars. I think this person is someone who succeeds at whatever he does. Anyway, I am completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): Professional installation and friendly technician I think the installer is as important as the product.
Comments (English): I went to the store to look at several products and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after thinking about it a bit more, I bought this one when it came up on Coupang. I am satisfied with the size inside. When you manually open the door, it stays in place as much as you lower it. You can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when you let go of it at 80 degrees. I love details like this. I am especially satisfied with the function that the door opens after washing. Rinse? I will not use this because it says that the door does not open if you only use the rinse function. The technician kindly informed me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, grains of rice and such can get rotting and start a cafeteria smell. Oh, I learned something new today. You can remove the strainer by holding the blue one and turning it. I also like how simple the program button is. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use, but the owner told me that the height of the upper basket inside is adjustable. The spoon basket also has a handle, which is nice. With the S or L models, you have to lay the spoons in the large basket on top to wash them, but this one has a separate, smaller basket, so it will be convenient to wash the spoons and move them to the spoon holder. The technician explained it well, so do I really need an instruction manual? I want to. But just in case, I have the manual. I'll write about the product. Disadvantages: For me who has difficulty deciding, I bought it without hesitation because it was only one color, but for those who like colorful things, there might be a disadvantage because there is no choice of color. Advantages: 1. Ample storage (I went to the store and looked at several major companies' products, and a new 14-person model was released. In my opinion, and with the naked eye, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in internal space.) 2. Door opening function after washing (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it's not this product. For reference, this product says the door doesn't open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with handle (The products of major companies don't have this, but there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But now that I've washed the dishes, I can't find the cutlery. It's so convenient to move it here.) 4. The menu pops up right away when reusing (After the test run, the power turns off automatically, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before pops up. It's so convenient for me who always uses only one function. It can raise my laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly and looked at the dishwasher. The technician also said that Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation and friendly technician I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was so friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first, and he told me not to empty the drawer or the bottom of the sink himself. The location of the drain in my house is weird, so I chose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and then installed it again. After putting it in, he cleaned it up after it was done, took the product box, and kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product was brought in. I told him that I purposely moved in without installing the flooring, but he moved it very carefully. Several installers have come, and although they have been late for more than an hour, or at least a few minutes, there has never been anyone like this. He came earlier than the appointment time, and when I told him that I was going out, he calmly said that he would wait. When I got there, he had already put the product up while he was waiting, and he had parked his car again so as not to disturb other cars. I think this person is someone who succeeds at whatever he does. Anyway, I am completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it.
Comments (English): I went to the store to look at several products and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after thinking about it a bit more, I bought this one when it came up on Coupang. With the S or L models, you have to lay the spoons in the large basket on top to wash them, but this one has a separate, smaller basket, so it will be convenient to wash the spoons and move them to the spoon holder. Advantages: 1. Ample storage (I went to the store and looked at several major companies' products, and a new 14-person model was released. In my opinion, and with the naked eye, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in internal space.) 2. Door opening function after washing (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it's not this product. For reference, this product says the door doesn't open when using function 7.) 3. But now that I've washed the dishes, I can't find the cutlery. It's so convenient to move it here.) 4. The menu pops up right away when reusing (After the test run, the power turns off automatically, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before pops up. It's so convenient for me who always uses only one function. It can raise my laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly and looked at the dishwasher. The technician also said that Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation and friendly technician I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was so friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first, and he told me not to empty the drawer or the bottom of the sink himself. The location of the drain in my house is weird, so I chose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and then installed it again. I told him that I purposely moved in without installing the flooring, but he moved it very carefully. Several installers have come, and although they have been late for more than an hour, or at least a few minutes, there has never been anyone like this. He came earlier than the appointment time, and when I told him that I was going out, he calmly said that he would wait. When I got there, he had already put the product up while he was waiting, and he had parked his car again so as not to disturb other cars. I think this person is someone who succeeds at whatever he does. Anyway, I am completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): He was so friendly.
Comments (English): I went to the store to look at several products and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after thinking about it a bit more, I bought this one when it came up on Coupang. I am satisfied with the size inside. When you manually open the door, it stays in place as much as you lower it. You can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when you let go of it at 80 degrees. I love details like this. I am especially satisfied with the function that the door opens after washing. Rinse? I will not use this because it says that the door does not open if you only use the rinse function. The technician kindly informed me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, grains of rice and such can get rotting and start a cafeteria smell. Oh, I learned something new today. You can remove the strainer by holding the blue one and turning it. I also like how simple the program button is. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use, but the owner told me that the height of the upper basket inside is adjustable. The spoon basket also has a handle, which is nice. With the S or L models, you have to lay the spoons in the large basket on top to wash them, but this one has a separate, smaller basket, so it will be convenient to wash the spoons and move them to the spoon holder. The technician explained it well, so do I really need an instruction manual? I want to. But just in case, I have the manual. I'll write about the product. Disadvantages: For me who has difficulty deciding, I bought it without hesitation because it was only one color, but for those who like colorful things, there might be a disadvantage because there is no choice of color. Advantages: 1. Ample storage (I went to the store and looked at several major companies' products, and a new 14-person model was released. In my opinion, and with the naked eye, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in internal space.) 2. Door opening function after washing (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it's not this product. For reference, this product says the door doesn't open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with handle (The products of major companies don't have this, but there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But now that I've washed the dishes, I can't find the cutlery. It's so convenient to move it here.) 4. The menu pops up right away when reusing (After the test run, the power turns off automatically, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before pops up. It's so convenient for me who always uses only one function. It can raise my laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly and looked at the dishwasher. The technician also said that Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation and friendly technician I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was so friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first, and he told me not to empty the drawer or the bottom of the sink himself. The location of the drain in my house is weird, so I chose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and then installed it again. After putting it in, he cleaned it up after it was done, took the product box, and kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product was brought in. I told him that I purposely moved in without installing the flooring, but he moved it very carefully. Several installers have come, and although they have been late for more than an hour, or at least a few minutes, there has never been anyone like this. He came earlier than the appointment time, and when I told him that I was going out, he calmly said that he would wait. When I got there, he had already put the product up while he was waiting, and he had parked his car again so as not to disturb other cars. I think this person is someone who succeeds at whatever he does. Anyway, I am completely satisfied with this product and service.

Comments (English): I went to the store to look at several products and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after thinking about it a bit more, I bought this one when it came up on Coupang. Disadvantages: For me who has difficulty deciding, I bought it without hesitation because it was only one color, but for those who like colorful things, there might be a disadvantage because there is no choice of color. Advantages: 1. Ample storage (I went to the store and looked at several major companies' products, and a new 14-person model was released. In my opinion, and with the naked eye, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in internal space.) 2. Door opening function after washing (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it's not this product. For reference, this product says the door doesn't open when using function 7.) 3. But now that I've washed the dishes, I can't find the cutlery. It's so convenient to move it here.) 4. The menu pops up right away when reusing (After the test run, the power turns off automatically, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before pops up. It's so convenient for me who always uses only one function. It can raise my laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly and looked at the dishwasher. The technician also said that Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation and friendly technician I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was so friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first, and he told me not to empty the drawer or the bottom of the sink himself. The location of the drain in my house is weird, so I chose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and then installed it again. After putting it in, he cleaned it up after it was done, took the product box, and kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product was brought in. I told him that I purposely moved in without installing the flooring, but he moved it very carefully. Several installers have come, and although they have been late for more than an hour, or at least a few minutes, there has never been anyone like this. He came earlier than the appointment time, and when I told him that I was going out, he calmly said that he would wait. When I got there, he had already put the product up while he was waiting, and he had parked his car again so as not to disturb other cars. I think this person is someone who succeeds at whatever he does. Anyway, I am completely satisfied with this product and service.

I think this person is someone who succeeds at whatever he does. Anyway, I am completely satisfied with this product and service.
