Sentence (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.
Comments (Original): 여러 제품들 매장가서 둘러보고 살가말가하다가 조금 더 고민해보고 사자 햇는데 쿠팡에 요게 떠서 구매햇는데 안에 크기 만족합니다.수동으로 문 열때 내리는 만큼 고정되네요.완전 90도 확 열수도 잇고 80도에서 손 놓아도 그대로 고정되고 요런 디테일 너무 좋아요특히 세척하고 나서 문열리는 기능 제일 만족합니다.린스?헹굼기능만 사용하면 문열림 없다니 요고는 사용하지 않기루.기사님이 친절하게 주1회정도는 걸름망 청소하라고 알려주셧어요. 아니면 밥알같은거 삭아서 급식실냄새 날수도 잇다고..오~오늘 또 새로운거  한가지 배웟습니다.걸름망은 파란색 잡고 돌리면 떼어낼수 잇어요.프로그램 버튼도 간단하게 되어 잇어서 좋아요.전 복잡한거 싫엉해서 늘 쓰던거만 사용하는지라 안에 윗층 바구니는 높이를 조절할수 잇다고 알려주셧어요.수저바구니는 친절하게 손잡이도 잇어요.S사나 L사 꺼는 위에 큰 바구니에 눕혀서 수저를 씻어야는데 요고는 바구니 작게 따로잇어서 수저 세척하고 수저통에 옮길때 편할거 같아요.기사님이 설명을 잘해주시니 설명서 굳이 필요하나???싶습니다.그래도 혹시 모르니 설명서는  갖고잇는거루.제품에 대해 작성해볼게요.단점:결정장애 잇는 저에게는 한가지색상이라 고민없이 구매햇는데,컬러풀한거 좋아하시는 분들에게는 색상선택의 여지가 없어서 아쉬울수도.장점:1.넉넉한 수납(매장가서 여러대기업 제품 봣엇는데,14인용이 새로 나왓더라고요.제 느낌으로, 육안으로 이 제품도 내부공간  별루 차이안나는듯 보입니다.)2.세척완료후 문열림기능(이 기능 없는 제품 써보니 세척하고나서도 깜박해버리면 안에서 말랏는데도 무언가 특유의 냄새와  찝찝함이 잇어요,잘 까먹거나 귀찮으신 분은 이 제품  아니라도 세척완료후 문열림 기능 잇는 제품 쓰세요.참고로 이 제품은  7번 기능 사용시에는 문열림 없다고 합니다)3.손잡이 달린 수저바구니(대기업제품은 이거 없고 그냥 위에 잇는 큰 바구니에 수저놓는곳 따로 잇더라고요.근데 지금 설거지 해보니 수저를 요기  담아서 옮기니 너무 편해요.)4.재이용시 전에 메뉴 바로 뜸(시운전 끝나니 알아서 전원 꺼지는데,사용하려고다시 켜니 전에 사용햇던 2번 메뉴가 똿 뜨네요.늘 한가지 기능만 사용하는 저에게는 너무 편리합니다.게으름의 게이지를 올리수 잇어요)5.착한 가격(매장가서 같은 제품 보시면 어머나~이가격이엿어 놀랠겁니다.저는 뜻하지 않게 매장가서 식세기를 둘러보고 와서.기사님도 쿠팡이 제일 저렴하다고 하셧어요.)6.전문적인 설치친절한 기사님저는 제품만큼 설치기사님도 중요한거 같아요.씽크대전문이신 기사님이 오셔서 설치해주셧어요.너무 친절하십니다.하부장절단이나 이런거 필요할때마다 먼저 물어봐주시고,서랍장 비우거나 씽크대 밑을 비우는것도 저에게 하지말라고 직접 하신다고 하시며,저희집 하수구 위치가 요상해서 자리선정을 2번 햇는데,직접 다 비우시고 다시 넣으시고,끝나고 청소도 하시고,제품박스도 가져가시고,제품 들어올때 바닥 기스나는지도 자꾸 확인하시더라고요.일부러 장판 안하고 이사들어왓다고 말씀드렷능데도 조심조심 옮기셧어요.다른제품 설치기사님들 몇분 다녀가셧는데,많게는 1시간 이상 적으면 몇분 늦은적은 잇어도 이런 분은 없엇어요.약속시간보다 일찍 오시고,제가 외출중이라 말씀드리니 차분한 말투로 기다리신다고 하셧어요.와보니 기다리시는 동안 제품은 이미  올려놓앗고,차를 다른 차들에 방해안되게 다시 자리 바꿔서 주차하시고 계시더라고요.무엇을 해도 성공한다는 사람이 이런분 아닐가 싶습니다.무튼 저는 이 제품 과 서비스 완전 만족합니다.

Sentence (English): I'm very satisfied with the size inside.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. Sentence (English): The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): I will write about the product.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

(I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): Professional installation.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): I think the installer is as important as the product.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them.
