(I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. This one came up on Coupang, so I bought it. I'm very satisfied with the size inside. When I manually open the door, it stays in place as long as I lower it. I can open it a full 90 degrees, and it stays in place even when I let go at 80 degrees. I love these details. I'm especially satisfied with the door opening function after washing. Rinse? I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. Cons: Since it was only one color, I bought it without hesitation, but those who like colorful things might be disappointed because there are no color options. Pros: 1. Plenty of storage. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. I've had several installers come by for other products, and while some were late, sometimes more than an hour, and sometimes a few minutes, they've never been this late. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do.
Comments (English): I looked at several products in stores and was debating whether to buy them or not, but after some more thought, I decided to buy them. I won't be using this because it says the door won't open if I just use the rinse function. The technician kindly advised me to clean the strainer about once a week. Otherwise, things like rice grains will get stuck and start to smell like a cafeteria. Oh, and I learned something new today. The strainer can be removed by holding the blue handle and turning it. The program buttons are also simple and nice. I hate complicated things, so I just use the ones I always use. The technician told me that the upper basket inside is height adjustable. The cutlery basket also has a handle, which is nice. With S or L size cutlery, you have to lay the cutlery on top of the large basket to wash it, but this one has a small, separate basket, so it seems convenient when washing the cutlery and moving it to the cutlery holder. The technician explained it well, so I wondered if I really needed the manual. But just in case, I brought the manual with me. I will write about the product. (I went to the store and looked at products from several major companies, and they had a new 14-person model. In my opinion, and with my own eyes, this product doesn't seem to have much difference in interior space.) 2. Door opening function after washing is complete. (I tried a product without this function, and even after washing it, if I forgot, there was a peculiar smell and an unpleasant feeling even though it dried inside. If you often forget or find it bothersome, use a product that has a door opening function after washing, even if it is not this product. For reference, this product says that the door does not open when using function 7.) 3. Cutlery basket with a handle. (Products from large companies do not have this, and there is a separate place to put cutlery in the large basket on top. But after doing the dishes now, I put the cutlery here and move it, and it is so convenient.). 4. The menu before reuse appears right away. (After the test run is over, the power turns off by itself, but when I turn it back on to use it, the 2nd menu I used before appears. It is so convenient for me, who always uses only one function. It can raise the laziness gauge.) 5. Reasonable price. (If you go to the store and see the same product, you'll be surprised at the price. I went to the store unexpectedly to look at dishwashers. The technician also said Coupang was the cheapest.) 6. Professional installation. Friendly technician. I think the installer is as important as the product. A technician who specializes in sinks came and installed it. He was very friendly. Whenever I needed to cut the lower part or something like that, he asked me first. He told me not to empty the drawers or the space under the sink and that he would do it himself. The drain in my house is in a weird location, so I had to choose the location twice, but he emptied it all himself and put it back in. He cleaned it after he was done and took the product box. He kept checking to see if there were any scratches on the floor when the product came in. I told him that I intentionally moved in without installing the floorboards, but he moved it very carefully. They arrived earlier than the appointed time, and when I told them I was out, they calmly said they'd wait. When I got back, they'd already set up the product while I was waiting, and they'd re-parked their car so it wouldn't interfere with other cars. I think this type of person is someone who succeeds at whatever they do. Anyway, I'm completely satisfied with this product and service.

Sentence (English): This is a modern diswasher that works fine.
Comments (English): [ Modern, but miss some of the old functionality ] || ---------------- || This is a modern diswasher that works fine. The first week we got it, it went out -- completely and inexplicably. It worked for a few loads, then it just wouldn't come on or work. That has never happpened with any other dishwasher I've owned or any other appliance in our house. It was still under warranty so they replaced the computer in it. It has worked fine ever since. We miss the functionality to turn off the drying mode. The dry mode always seems to cause damage to so many items and wastes electricity in our experience. You still have to open the dishwasher after it runs and allow everything to dry. It's extremely quiet, but I would trade noise for that old functionaility to skip the drying mode. Also, I cannot get used to the inside setup. It seems to lack flexibility if you have more larger items in a load. And, you can't really put your larger utensils in the basket on the lower level because they will block the spinning part above it. Lastly, the door is difficult to open; you really have to pull much harder than you think you would need to. If none of these issues bothers you, then this is a quiet and good dishwasher that gets dishes clean, but not necessarily dry. It's also very sleek and modern looking.

Sentence (English): I have had my GE dishwasher for a few weeks now.
Comments (English): [ Nice machine, Bad rack design. ] || ---------------- || I have had my GE dishwasher for a few weeks now. It seems O.K and cleans the dishes well on the sensor setting. It also dries them well on the lower power boost setting.The things I don't like are the racks. There is no place to set my cereal bolls in the upright position. The tines are too close together. Also there is a lot of space between the lower and 2nd rack. This put the 2nd rack too close to the 3rd rack for my “Big Gulp” cups. This makes the large bottle water jets kind of “useless” (nice Idea though). The 3 rack is a bit too short to fit the cereal bolls in without hitting the inside top of the dishwasher. It's a big machine but the rack design makes it impossible to go more than a day without running it.Finally on the installation: The drain tube connection was a bit oversized. I had to put a big clamp on it to get it to seal.

Sentence (English): After several weeks with our new dishwasher, we started realizing items that have changed from our previous GE dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Performs quite well, but some unwelcome features ] || ---------------- || After several weeks with our new dishwasher, we started realizing items that have changed from our previous GE dishwasher. The build quality is definitely better since the interior is stainless steel and the unit as a whole feels well build. The dislikes are the fact that the silverware rack has been moved to the side of the drawer from the previous location at the front of the drawer. I'm not sure why this made sense and got to production. I have had several dishwashers over the years and have never had a problem fitting any of my dishes, pots and pans into any of my dishwashers. On my new Bosch all of the tines of the bottom rack are angled which severly limits what and how much will fit in the unit. A water bottle cannot even stand up straight in the bottom rack. The silverware rack does not stay in place and the covers are difficult to change once you have placed items in the rack. The same goes for the upper rack.
